description: This Java class 'SnmpTransportContext' manages SNMP device sessions within the Thingsboard platform, including device session establishment, updates, deletion, and handling transport list changes. It interacts with various services for device management, session handling, and SNMP-specific operations.

classes.name: SnmpTransportContext
classes.description: Manages SNMP device sessions, including establishing, updating, and destroying sessions, and handling device and transport list events within the Thingsboard SNMP transport module.

methods.name: fetchDevicesAndEstablishSessions
methods.description: Initiates device session bootstrap process after startup.

methods.name: bootstrapWithRetries
methods.description: Fetches SNMP device IDs in batches and attempts to establish sessions with retries.

methods.name: establishDeviceSession
methods.description: Establishes a session for a specific SNMP device.

methods.name: updateDeviceSession
methods.description: Updates an existing device session with new configuration data.

methods.name: destroyDeviceSession
methods.description: Destroys a device session and cleans up resources.

methods.name: registerSessionMsgListener
methods.description: Registers message listener for device session authentication.

methods.name: registerTransportSession
methods.description: Registers a transport session after device authentication.

methods.name: onDeviceUpdatedOrCreated
methods.description: Handles device creation or update events to manage sessions accordingly.

methods.name: onDeviceDeleted
methods.description: Handles device deletion by destroying the session.

methods.name: onDeviceProfileUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to device profiles and updates sessions accordingly.

methods.name: onSnmpTransportListChanged
methods.description: Updates device sessions based on changes in SNMP transport list.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service during bean destruction.
